items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Between Mr. Singleton and her, they kept my books in perfect order for years.

ctx.x: Well, if I could interject, I think she had a lot to do with it. Not only was she Wells’ bookkeeper, she started keeping my books as well. She kept everything in order along with an accountant who is a relative. Between Mr. Singleton and her, they kept my books in perfect order for years.
When you get older, you start to think just how valuable it was.
